messages:
sara: Quick sync  running a 2h variant lab to finalize Hosted / Dedicated / Private hero lines + webinar landing + inbound routing. Goal: 2 hero variants per mode + HubSpot routing wireframe.

leo: +1. Recommend one PLG-forward hero for Hosted and one technical/benchmark hero.

anya: i'll bring a micro-benchmark (cost-per-1k tokens with batching) and two short customer quotes.

matt: i'll sketch HubSpot fields: Use case, Team size, Compliance checkbox, Expected RPS, Model preference. Routing: if team_size>50 OR compliance=true -> enterprise-sales; if use_case==evaluation -> webinar_nurture; else -> demo_queue. Add utm_campaign=tri_mode_site and hidden fields.

julia: timeboxes: 25m hero variants, 35m body/proofs, 25m webinar landing, 25m routing + tracking, 10m next steps.

audience-bot: Reminder: attach pre-read 24h before meeting. Template: ./copy/briefs/variant-lab-brief.md

sara: hero test axes: latency clarity, cost transparency, deployment choice. Leo draft lines?

leo: Hosted A: "Start in minutes  production-ready inference"; Hosted B: "Instantly add LLM features  no infra".

leo: Dedicated A: "Reserved capacity  SLA-backed throughput"; Dedicated B: "Predictable throughput  optimized unit cost".

leo: Private A: "Run inference in your VPC  enterprise controls"; Private B: "Air-gapped LLM serving  total data custody".

anya: will include a small chart showing batching reduces per-token cost ~25-35% for common seq lengths.

matt: also propose confirmation page tracking: window.dataLayer.push({event: 'lead_submitted', utm_campaign: 'tri_mode_site'}); and 48h auto-nudge workflow.

julia: owners: leo (heroes + launch post draft), anya (benchmarks + slides), matt (HubSpot wiring + tracking), sara (final sign-off), julia (facilitation). Pre-read due Tue 5pm PT.

sara: great. post-lab deliverables: final hero text, 2 launch-post angles (benchmark-first, customer-first), HubSpot routing JSON, webinar landing wireframe. Aim to publish launch post + webinar invite next Wed.

leo: will draft the two launch-post angles: one succinct technical thread, one narrative customer quote lead.

anya: attaching benchmark PDF to pre-read.

matt: drafting HubSpot fields now.

sara: thanks team  see you at the lab. :rocket:
